title: DLL Hook Unity NOP padding boundary
contracts: dllhook.c owns only the active detour envelope it writes at the source function entry
The entry detour transfers normal control flow before any tail bytes execute
NOP-padding from UsedCount to ByteCount changes the writable code span and compatibility surface
The old Unity breakage is runtime compatibility evidence, not proof that NOP padding is impossible
A future NOP-padding patch must first publish a checked ByteCount and UsedCount contract from the trampoline owner
This SREV does not change detour bytes trampoline generation page protection cache flushing or hook policy
runtime_gate: Any future source behavior change that enables NOP padding must run Windows x86 WoW64 x64 hook smoke tests third-party detour-envelope compatibility tests and a Unity runtime smoke
